prompt:
Hey, we had a really bad incident last night with our checkout service — took down payments for nearly half an hour and hit some enterprise customers. My on-call team dropped all their raw notes, chat logs, and metrics in `/workspace/incidents/2024-07-15/`. It's a complete mess — duplicate lines, timestamps out of order, half-formed thoughts.

I need you to go through all of that and produce a clean, structured write-up called `incident_timeline.md` that I can send to the VP of Engineering and use as the foundation for tomorrow's post-incident review meeting.

It needs to be actually useful and actionable — not just a narrative. We need clear priorities, concrete next steps (split between what we must do immediately versus what can wait until later in the week), who owns each item, rough timelines, and an honest picture of what we still don't know. Also flag what could go wrong with the proposed fixes and what we'd do if the main plan doesn't work.

All claims must be traceable to the actual logs and data — no guessing.
